Identified as this saint because: Russian Menaion Reader plate «07201»: church-month 07 = March, day 20, this folder's feast in all four calendars. The series draws exactly three plates for that day — «Иоанн», «Сергий», «Патрикий» — and those three names in that order are this folder's own Russian name form, «Иоанн, Сергий, Патрикий и прочие в обители святого Саввы убиенные», the martyrs slain in the lavra of Saint Sabbas in 796. So the plate is of one of the folder's own named martyrs, John, and not of any other John: the day carries nobody else. STATED PLAINLY because the folder is a group and the plate is one man — the hero will show John alone, not the company.
